dedupe_keys.name: dynamic population presence linked to home neighbourhoods in the helsinki metropolitan area a 24 hour weekday and weekend dataset

description: Dynamic population presence linked to home neighbourhoods in the Helsinki Metropolitan Area: A 24-hour weekday and weekend dataset is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Kerli Müürisepp et al. In this article, we present a 24-hour population presence dataset from the Helsinki Metropolitan Area (HMA), Finland. This population-level and metropolitan-wide dataset shows hourly population distribution across HMA neighbourhoods on an average weekday (Mon–Fri) and an average weekend day (Sat–Sun), and links people’s hourly presence to their home neighbourhoods. Coverage: national (FI); published in 2026. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
